thought.text: Both packages have no unsatisfied dependencies. Let me test installation in a scratch container of the base image:

reasoning_content:
No dependencies on the scripts package. Both debs can be installed without issues.

Next, test with a disposable container: install both debs with dpkg, then check the routing extension:

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments:
{"command": "docker run --rm -v /tmp/pgrouting-debs:/debs -w /debs postgis/postgis:17-3.5 sh -c '
cp /debs/*.deb /tmp/ && cd /tmp &&
sha256sum -c <(echo "cbbec04156828a4d9eb11a73560b49c8312a46b30534053608d272329af27ee2  postgresql-17-pgrouting_3.8.0-1.pgdg110+1_amd64.deb"; echo "594cbaca6af23694486ef46f7ec23c49061444562eb0ab2a13bb169bcb6259fa  postgresql-17-pgrouting-scripts_3.8.0-1.pgdg110+1_all.deb") &&
dpkg -i postgresql-17-pgrouting-scripts_*.deb postgresql-17-pgrouting_*.deb &&
echo "=== extension files ===" && ls /usr/lib/postgresql/17/extension/ | grep -i routing
'", "description": "Test-install pgrouting debs in scratch container of base image", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "summary": "Test pgrouting dpkg install in scratch container"}
